title: Florian Grunow, Niklaus Schiess: Lifting the Fog on Red Star OS
summary: A 32C3 talk dissecting Red Star OS, North Korea's state-built operating system. The speakers explain its internals and how it invades users' privacy, including file watermarking.
why: HN points to it as a deep dive into the surveillance features of North Korea's OS and the extent of that state's digital tracking.

quote.text: A deep dive into the surveillance features of North Korea's operating system
